summary: Rename the generic ide locals in coru cli to stage-accurate names

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'ide' in packages/coru/src/coru/cli.py (planfile ticket PLF-041, reported at line 447, the def line of _cmd_repair_run) by replacing the generic local with a stage-accurate name per binding site: shell_ide (_terminal_ide_hint, the IDE owning this shell, first element of the _terminal_shell_context() unpack whose docstring already names the stage), lane_ide (_cmd_repair_history, _cmd_repair_run and _cmd_sync, the lane IDE resolved from _default_lane(args.ide, args.instance) - one shared name because all three bind the identical resolved-lane value, landing at 3 scopes below the >= 5 threshold), shorthand_ide (_maybe_rewrite_ide_auto_shorthand, the lane-hint IDE token recognized in raw argv for the 'coru cursor auto' -> 'coru auto cursor' rewrite). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'ide' group drops from 5 scopes to 0 and the file mutation record count stays 92 (pure rename - every ide is read after its binding, so nothing is inlined or removed). No behavior change: same _terminal_shell_context call, same lane-filter log text, same _koru_autopilot_env_payload/_run_lane_repair/Plan seeding arguments, same shorthand rewrite result. Function parameters and the Plan/SessionContext/AutoReadiness dataclass fields named 'ide' are not counted by the detector (body-only visit, AnnAssign unhandled) and stay unchanged; target_ide and term_ide are already stage-accurate at 1 scope each and stay. No other file touched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this repository, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, log-text, argument or interface change

No rename of the ide parameter of _project_for_lane, the Plan/SessionContext/AutoReadiness dataclass fields, or attribute reads like args.ide/resolved.ide/bootstrap.ide (not counted by the detector: parameters and class scope)
No rename of target_ide or term_ide (already stage-accurate, 1 scope each)
No new shared lane-resolution helper; the three _default_lane unpacks stay per-command so each command keeps its own resolution stage

No import-block reordering: the 2 pre-existing I001 findings on the coru.cli facade import block are the verified origin/main baseline (A/B on the unmodified file) and the facade import order is deliberately preserved

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming inside one module, no extraction. Each function that mutated the generic name 'ide' gets the name of its own pipeline stage: shell_ide for the shell-context detection hint, lane_ide for the command-resolved default lane (shared by the three commands that unpack the identical _default_lane value), shorthand_ide for the argv lane-hint token. The generic name 'ide' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely while the coru.cli facade surface (imports, dataclasses, function signatures) is untouched, matching the koru facade late-binding constraint that cli.py patch targets must stay stable. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'ide' mutation group of exactly 5 scopes - _terminal_ide_hint, _cmd_repair_history, _cmd_repair_run, _cmd_sync, _maybe_rewrite_ide_auto_shorthand - matching the ticket's 'spans 5 functions'; after the rename the 'ide' group is empty, the file mutation record count stays 92 (pure rename), lane_ide lands at 3 scopes, shell_ide and shorthand_ide at exactly 1 scope, and no other group newly reaches the threshold (the previous runner-up 'instance' stays at 3 scopes).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named ide again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file AST, baseline vs renamed content of packages/coru/src/coru/cli.py>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports an 'ide' mutation group of 5 scopes (_terminal_ide_hint, _cmd_repair_history, _cmd_repair_run, _cmd_sync, _maybe_rewrite_ide_auto_shorthand) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 5 functions'; renamed content reports an 'ide' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count stays 92 (pure rename); lane_ide lands at 3 scopes, shell_ide and shorthand_ide at exactly 1 scope; no other variable group reaches the >= 5 threshold.

The coru cli test module exercising the renamed paths (test_coru_cli.py covers the ide auto shorthand rewrite, sync command lane seeding, repair history/run lane resolution and the terminal ide hint) passes unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals - and ruff reports no new findings on the touched file (the 2 pre-existing I001 import-order findings are the verified origin/main baseline via A/B on the unmodified file).
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
